<thought>We need a template that describes deprotection of a TBS group: breaking the O‑Si bond and forming an aliphatic hydroxyl. In the forward reaction (deprotection) the functional group “t-butyldimethylsilyl” is broken and an “aliphatic hydroxyls” group is formed. We'll search the template catalog with these criteria and then return the mapped reaction SMILES and template ID of the best match.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
